metadata.description: 19 mods for Claude Code. One panel.

plugins.name: modz
plugins.description: The MODZ panel. Opens beside the chat with a live line from every installed mod, one click to each mod's own pane.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Every agent gets a face: progress, cost and time for each subagent, live, in the Agents pane and a band above the prompt. Other chats waiting on you show at the top.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Orchestrated delivery: the session model plans and reviews, five tiered worker agents implement. Pairs with savvy-progress.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: A file tree of what Claude touches: what it is doing now, the files touched this turn and their git status.

plugins.name: plan-steps
plugins.description: The plan's steps as Claude works through them, from the task list, an approved plan or a plan file. The plan comes back after /clear and compaction.

plugins.name: transceiver
plugins.description: Beta. Your team, inside Claude. Chat with teammates and let your agents ask theirs about the repo, at zero tokens.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Risky commands wait for your OK. rm -rf, git reset --hard, force pushes and migrations are held with exactly what they would change; so is an edit to a file another chat just changed.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops keys and tokens before they land: scans writes, edits, git add and commit, and blocks committing .env. Pasted keys reach the model as placeholders; /rec masks the screen.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: A silent git snapshot before each turn's first write. /checkpoints lists the turns and undoes one.

plugins.name: test-badge
plugins.description: After a turn that edited source, runs tests and lint in the background and shows the result as a badge. Watches your PR's GitHub CI too.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replays the last turn's edits step by step, each tied to its plan step, with a coloured diff; earlier turns and past sessions too.

plugins.name: session-budget
plugins.description: A spend budget per session, as a share of the 5-hour limit or in dollars: a notice at 80%, a stop at 100%, and a question before new subagents when the 5-hour window runs low.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm through breaks and shows what a cold send would cost, after a break or a model change. Warming uses tokens.

plugins.name: hud-pro
plugins.description: One quiet line above the prompt: the 5-hour limit and its reset, 7-day use, context and session cost. The Usage pane shows what fills the context and 7 or 30 days of usage history.

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: A notification when a long turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you, with optional sound packs.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Spots corrections in your prompts worth keeping and saves them to the CLAUDE.md you choose. /mine turns friction that repeats across past chats into ideas.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Themes for the transcript: tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words. /skin switches them live.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A browser inside the terminal: preview sites and HTML files and let the agent drive it. Terminal only.

plugins.name: effort-router
plugins.description: Shows each turn's effort and model. In auto mode, light prompts go at low effort.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Before the context fills, writes a handoff note and hands it once to your next fresh chat in this repo.
